LESSON: KUANDIKA 10.3.1 BARUA RASMI YA KUOMBA MSAMAHA

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: KISWAHILI
Strand: Strand 10
Topic 10.3: Kuandika 10.3.1 Barua Rasmi ya Kuomba Msamaha

SEHEMU 1: KARIBU

Habari! Leo tutajifunza kuhusu Kuandika 10.3.1 Barua Rasmi ya Kuomba Msamaha. Soma, angalia mifano, fanya mazoezi, kisha jaribu jaribio la marekebisho.

SEHEMU 2: UTAPATA KUJUA NINI

Mwisho wa somo hili, utaweza:

1. kueleza umuhimu wa barua rasmi ya kuomba msamaha
2. kutambua ujumbe katika barua rasmi ya kuomba msamaha
3. kutambua vipengele vya kimuundo vya barua rasmi ya kuomba msamaha

SEHEMU 3: JIFUNZE HATUA KWA HATUA

1. kueleza umuhimu wa barua rasmi ya kuomba msamaha
   In simple words: practise until you can kueleza umuhimu wa barua rasmi ya kuomba msamaha. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. kutambua ujumbe katika barua rasmi ya kuomba msamaha
   In simple words: practise until you can kutambua ujumbe katika barua rasmi ya kuomba msamaha. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. kutambua vipengele vya kimuundo vya barua rasmi ya kuomba msamaha
   In simple words: practise until you can kutambua vipengele vya kimuundo vya barua rasmi ya kuomba msamaha. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SEHEMU 4: MIFANO

Example 1: Talk about Kuandika 10.3.1 Barua Rasmi ya Kuomba Msamaha using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SEHEMU 5: JARIBU HIVI

1. Underline two new ideas about Kuandika 10.3.1 Barua Rasmi ya Kuomba Msamaha in the examples.
2. Explain Kuandika 10.3.1 Barua Rasmi ya Kuomba Msamaha to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Kuandika 10.3.1 Barua Rasmi ya Kuomba Msamaha.
4. Show that you can: kueleza umuhimu wa barua rasmi ya kuomba msamaha

SEHEMU 6: KAZI YA KUFANYA

1. Write five sentences about Kuandika 10.3.1 Barua Rasmi ya Kuomba Msamaha using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Kuandika 10.3.1 Barua Rasmi ya Kuomba Msamaha important for a Grade 7 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SEHEMU: KUMBUKA

1. kueleza umuhimu wa barua rasmi ya kuomba msamaha
2. kutambua ujumbe katika barua rasmi ya kuomba msamaha
3. kutambua vipengele vya kimuundo vya barua rasmi ya kuomba msamaha

Sasa fanya Jaribio la Marekebisho. Angalia Majibu baada tu ya kumaliza.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
